description: V0.5a integration smoke test: the external LLM agent (agents/llm, live, one local model) beside the no-op baseline on the bundled sustainable scenario, one fresh development seed, 7 days, daily decisions. It shows that a model can take part in a complete, replayable session; it is not a performance benchmark. Run from the repository root with DREAMTEAM_LLM_BASE_URL set.
seedPlan: Chosen 2026-10-27, before any run on it and without reference to earlier results: 40601, the next unused block after V0.4a's 40401-40405 and V0.4b's 40501-40505. It appears nowhere else in the repository. Not a reference seed (1001-1020), not a V0.2 development seed (901-910), not drawn from any reserved stream; the sealed holdout guard accepts it.

external.description: the LLM agent (agents/llm/llm_agent.py, llm-agent v1, prompt llm-agent-prompt/v1), live, with the model and limits of docs/benchmark/v05a-dev/llm-settings.json; stateless, one validated batch at most per decision point
